noResultsHint: Try a different name or product code.
name: Product name
addTitle: How would you like to add stock?

scanVoiceHint: Scan a barcode, then tell us what arrived.
manualHint: Type product details at your own pace.
nothingSaved: Stock only changes after you review and save.
scanHint: Keep the barcode or QR code inside the frame.
cameraHint: Camera access is optional. You can always type the code.
codeHint: The code stays with this product through every step.
voiceHint: Say the product name, description and quantity.

reviewHint: Check the transcript and details. You can correct anything before adding it to your list.

sessionEmptyHint: Scan and confirm a product to start a delivery.
successHint: Your inventory and movement history are up to date.

countHint: Count what is on the shelf. Explain any difference from the record.

noOrdersHint: Reorder from a product’s detail screen when you need more stock.
supplierSubtitle: Contacts and orders, all in one place.
alertsTitle: A little attention goes a long way
alertsHint: Review low stock and upcoming expiry dates before they interrupt your day.
noAlertsHint: No products need attention with your current alert settings.
historyHint: A clear record of what came in, went out or was counted.
noHistoryHint: Your first saved delivery will appear here.
alertSettingsHint: Expiry reminders and product stock thresholds
offlineHint: You can browse saved inventory. Reconnect to make changes.
aboutHint: Try the full workflow with sample data
welcome: A clearer view of your warehouse.
welcomeHint: Receive faster. Keep stock accurate. Know what needs your attention.
prototypeNote: Interactive prototype. Camera support varies; cloud voice, sign-in and team authorization require production integrations.
teamNote: Team roles are a preview. Secure invitations and permissions will be enforced by the production API.
teamFullHint: An owner can deactivate a member before inviting someone new.
photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 12 MB. Photos are resized for storage.
thresholdHint: Remind me when available stock reaches this amount.
expiryHint: Expiry is recorded for this receiving batch.
sameProductHint: This code already belongs to a product. Confirmed quantity will be added to its available stock.
cameraUnavailable: Camera scanning is not supported here. Enter a code or choose a sample.
cameraDenied: Camera is unavailable or permission was denied. Enter the code to continue.
micUnavailable: Speech recognition is not available here. Use a sample phrase or type the details.
micDenied: Voice capture failed. Check microphone permission, try again, or type the details.
voiceMissing: We could not find a quantity. Please enter it before continuing.
qtyInvalid: Enter a whole number greater than zero.
qtyZeroInvalid: Enter a whole number of zero or more.
thresholdInvalid: The low-stock threshold must be zero or a positive whole number.
insufficient: There is not enough stock. Enter a quantity within the available amount.
reasonRequired: Please explain the difference before saving this count.
codeRequired: Enter a barcode or product code.
duplicate: This SKU or barcode already exists. Open the existing product to receive stock.
draftDuplicate: This product is already in the receiving list. Edit or remove that entry first.
storageError: We could not save your changes. Browser storage may be full or unavailable. Your draft is still here.
conflict: Inventory changed in another tab. Review the latest stock before saving again.
photoInvalid: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image up to 12 MB.
supplierRequired: Choose a supplier for this order.
invalidExpiryDays: Enter a reminder period from 0 to 365 days.
settingsInvalid: Warehouse name and location are required.
dateInvalid: Expiry cannot be earlier than the stock-in date.
sessionNotice: Confirmed items are drafts until you save the delivery.
onboardTeam: One warehouse. Five people. One clear picture.
inventoryHint: Find it. Check it. Keep it moving.
receiptNote: Every stock change keeps a before-and-after record.
cameraActive: Camera is ready. Hold the code steady.
emptySessionHint: Add a product before saving this delivery.
signInHint: This demonstration opens a sample workspace. No real account or password is required.
countRetained: Physical counts are retained from the existing flow boards.
reorderSavedHint: Await the supplier’s reply, then confirm shipping.
confirmShippingHint: Update this status only after the supplier confirms.
itemDetailsHint: Add a photo, supplier and any extra details before adding this item to your receiving list.
photoOptional: Help your team recognize this item.
supplierFormHint: Keep the supplier’s contact details together for future orders.
emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, or leave it blank.
supplierDuplicate: A supplier with this name already exists. Choose them from the dropdown.
